meta.note: Operators: class, nationality (country id), signature gadget, class tool, ultimate, passive, looks, voice lines and level unlocks. Ultimate charge comes from playing the role (damage, kills, revives, repairs, resupplies, spotting).

breacher.name: Breaching launcher
breacher.desc: Fires a charge that blows open walls and doors (2 charges, 12 s recharge).

torch.name: Repair torch
torch.desc: Hold to repair vehicles, turrets and deployables. Overheats.

defib.name: Defibrillator
defib.desc: Instant revive at arm's length (10 s recharge). Can also stun an enemy at point blank.

scope.name: Spotting scope
scope.desc: Zoomed view that marks every enemy in the reticle for your team, and paints targets for strikes.

list.name: Kestrel
list.bio: Former canyon courier from Dustwater. Never waits for a door.

gadget.name: Dash jetpack
gadget.desc: Burst of thrust in any direction — across gaps, onto roofs, out of trouble. 3 charges.

ult.name: Afterburn
ult.desc: 10 s of unlimited dashes, a hover glide and faster reloads.

passive.name: Momentum
passive.desc: Sprint and slide 8% faster; mantles are quicker.

list.name: Ironside
list.bio: Riot-line veteran from the Old Quarter. Plants a wall and walks it forward.

gadget.name: Deployable shield wall
gadget.desc: A 3 m bullet-proof wall with view slits (600 HP, 35 s). 1 charge.

ult.name: Battering charge
ult.desc: Raise a heavy shield and charge 25 m — knocks soldiers down and smashes through walls.

passive.name: Plated
passive.desc: Takes 10% less explosive damage; armour wears 20% slower.

list.name: Rivet
list.bio: Harbourfront mechanic. Fixes your tank, then blows up theirs.

gadget.name: Sticky anti-armour mine
gadget.desc: Sticks to any surface; detonates under enemy vehicles. 2 charges.

ult.name: Breaker volley
ult.desc: Paint a target: six guided anti-armour rockets strike it.

list.name: Bastion
list.bio: Builds research stations on glaciers. Builds forts anywhere else.

gadget.name: Deployable cover + sentry
gadget.desc: Drop hard cover (2) or a sentry turret (1, 300 HP, 60 s) — hold X for the turret.

ult.name: Fortified outpost
ult.desc: Air-drops a bunker with a heavy turret and an ammo station.

passive.name: Field engineer
passive.desc: Deployables have 30% more HP; can repair them by hand.

list.name: Mercy-6
list.bio: Riverboat medic. Six tours, six letters home, zero patients left behind.

gadget.name: Healing drone
gadget.desc: A drone that follows the most hurt teammate nearby and heals 10 HP/s (25 s).

ult.name: Lifeline
ult.desc: A pulse that revives every downed ally within 30 m and heals everyone to full.

passive.name: Swift hands
passive.desc: Revives in 1.2 s; revived allies come back with 60 HP.

list.name: Quartermaster
list.bio: Ran caravans through the Ashkar passes. Nobody runs dry on her watch.

gadget.name: Ammo + armour crate
gadget.desc: Drops a crate that refills ammo and repairs armour plates for the squad (3 uses each).

ult.name: Smoke barrage
ult.desc: Six smoke shells walk a wall of smoke across the target line, plus a resupply drop.

passive.name: Pack mule
passive.desc: Carries 50% more ammo and one extra grenade.

list.name: Wren
list.bio: Grew up fixing drones in Dustwater. Pip, her first, still flies.

gadget.name: Recon drone 'Pip'
gadget.desc: Fly a drone (30 s): everything in its view is marked for the team; a zap stuns soldiers.

ult.name: Drone swarm
ult.desc: Six drones circle a 60 m area for 15 s, marking all enemies and harassing them.

passive.name: Sixth sense
passive.desc: Enemies aiming at you within 30 m are flagged on your HUD.

list.name: Ghost
list.bio: Polar scout. Moves through blizzards the way others cross a room.

gadget.name: Cloaking cape
gadget.desc: Near-invisible for 6 s (breaks when you fire). Also carries three motion sensors.

ult.name: Phantom
ult.desc: 15 s cloak that doesn't break when you fire, with thermal vision.

passive.name: Quiet feet
passive.desc: Footsteps are 50% quieter; immune to motion sensors.
